intelligence.essence: He wants the ultimate algorithm — not only for the token spend but for production: "are we spending in the smartest possible way? Are we also producing in the smartest possible way? I think the answer to both is not even close. So we gotta get close." The pie, from measured sizes: context re-read ~40%, full page re-reads ~30%, rework ~15%, background loops ~10%, idle/pokes ~5%. At ~26M tokens an hour, 100M lasts ~4 hours, not a week. The algorithm is seven rules: one wake one job; never re-read unchanged bytes; slim context per agent; whole-list rounds; loops earn their keep or stop; prove by tap once, phone first; score finished pages ÷ tokens every hour.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your lunchbox, sweetheart — every morning you pack the WHOLE kitchen into it, even though you only need one sandwich! That's silly, sweetheart — and it takes forever! So now we pack just the sandwich, sweetheart — one job, one lunchbox, and we check our work by touching it once. Smart packing, smart eating, sweetheart!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every morning we carried the whole pantry to the table, dear, just to make one cup of tea. No wonder the day ran out, love! So now we carry just the cup, dear — one job at a time, we check only what changed, and every hour we count what we finished against what we spent. Same care, love — much lighter carrying.
